auditor_maya: Hi team — auditors spotted an RBAC change (rolebinding rb-470) during CVE-2026-0789 triage on 2026-09-08. Need: raw KMS/CloudTrail events showing no external key export, a short rollback timeline/note, remediation PR + deploy IDs, and whether any CMK policy edits occurred in the 09:00-10:30Z window. Please paste presigned paths.

Tom-sec: Thanks — we'll assemble a minimal evidence bundle. Raw CloudTrail preferred. We'll also include an envelope HMAC if present.

Luca-sre: Uploaded to presigned S3: s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/1977772001/ (cloudtrail_kms.json.gz, siem_rbac_alerts.log.gz, rb-470-rollback.txt, cve-0789-fix.md, manifest.sig, kms-envelope-hmac.b64)

Nina-eng: Rollback note (excerpt): "Reverted rolebinding rb-470 at 2026-09-08T09:18:27Z by nina-eng via ops-playbook v4.1 after canary flagged expanded admin write scope. Post-revert canary green at 09:24Z. Ticket: SEC-7241."

Tom-sec: CloudTrail snippet (excerpt):
```
{
  "eventTime": "2026-09-08T09:12:03Z",
  "eventName": "GenerateDataKey",
  "userIdentity": { "type": "AssumedRole", "arn": "arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/redwood-rbac-agent/agent-121" },
  "requestParameters": { "keyId": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/kk77-ll88" }
}
```

Tom-sec: Envelope HMAC at kms-envelope-hmac.b64 verified locally (verifier key ck-33). No Decrypt events with externalRecipient metadata in the 09:00-10:30Z window.

Luca-sre: CVE PR: https://git.redwood.ai/infra/security/pull/1677
Deploy IDs: deploy-usw2-20260908-3, rolling-canary-20260908-1

Tom-sec: CMK policy events: confirmed no PutKeyPolicy, DisableKey, ScheduleKeyDeletion, or UpdateKeyDescription for key kk77-ll88 between 2026-09-08T08:30Z and 2026-09-08T11:00Z.

compliance-bot: Automated check: manifest.sig verified with compliance key ck-17. Hashes match uploaded artifacts. :white_check_mark:

auditor_maya: Excellent — this should be enough for CC6.2 mapping. If we need signed HSM attestations or screenshots for the packet I'll follow up. Thanks all :thumbsup:
